mensajes.limite: This command only prepares the private identifier file for the administration runtime. It does not connect to the database or show identifiers; hand over the fingerprint through the private approval channel.
mensajes.uso_invalido: Provide originals, certificates, source, acknowledgement, material, provider, output and text catalogue, each at a different path. The vec-admin configuration is optional and must also use its own path.
mensajes.entrada_insegura: A private file cannot be read. Use owned 0600 files of up to 64 KiB in a 0700 directory outside any repository and without links.
mensajes.entrada_invalida: An input file does not have the expected format or has missing or extra fields.
mensajes.entradas_divergentes: The files do not belong to the same preparation: people, acknowledged accounts, certificate authority or material fingerprint differ. Nothing was written.
mensajes.configuracion_admin_divergente: The administration runtime identity configuration does not use the same provider as proveedor.json. Nothing was written.
mensajes.proveedor_no_disponible: The pseudonym provider could not be loaded with the given configuration. Nothing was written.
mensajes.coordenadas_divergentes: The provider uses a different scheme, domain or key than the confirmed material. Nothing was written.
mensajes.sujeto_divergente: The subject fingerprint computed now does not match the confirmed one. Nothing was written.
mensajes.cuenta_divergente: The administration account fingerprint computed now does not match the confirmed one. Nothing was written.
mensajes.alias_ordinario_divergente: The ordinary account fingerprint the runtime will compute does not match the confirmed one. Nothing was written.
mensajes.salida_insegura: The output cannot be created: it already exists, its directory is not private (0700 and owned) or it is inside a repository.
mensajes.salida_rechazada_retirada: The runtime loader does not accept the written file. It was removed.
mensajes.salida_rechazada_sin_retirar: The runtime loader does not accept the written file and it could not be removed. Delete it manually before retrying and do not configure it.
mensajes.identificadores_preparados: Identifier file prepared. Configure its path and this fingerprint in the administration runtime.
